name: cuda-toolkit
description: Installs NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit and adds it to PATH

sub-packages.description: Only installs specified subpackages, must be in the form of a JSON array. For example, if you only want to install nvcc and visual studio integration: ["nvcc",

non-cuda-sub-packages.description: Only installs specified subpackages that do not have the cuda prefix, must be in the form of a JSON array. For example, if you only want to install libcublas an

method.description: Installation method, can be either 'local' or 'network'. 'local' downloads the entire installer with all packages and runs that (you can still only install cert

linux-local-args.description: (Linux and 'local' method only) override arguments for the linux .run installer. For example if you don't want samples use ["--toolkit"] double quotes required!

use-github-cache.description: Use GitHub cache to cache downloaded installer on GitHub servers

use-local-cache.description: Use local cache to cache downloaded installer on the local runner

log-file-suffix.description: Suffix of log file name in artifact
